### Role
As a **[type of user]**,

### Action
I want to **[perform an action / access a feature]**,

### Business Value
So that **[I achieve a specific benefit, value, or outcome]**.

---

### Acceptance Criteria
```gherkin
Given [context or initial condition]
When [action is taken]
Then [expected outcome occurs]
```

- [ ] Given [context or initial condition], When [action is taken], Then [expected outcome occurs]
- [ ] Given [a user performs a task], When [data is submitted], Then [the system responds accordingly]
- [ ] Given [invalid inputs are provided], When [submission is attempted], Then [an appropriate error is displayed]
